typeProperties.script:
parameters{
	EBillPreferenceArchiveFilePath as string (),
	EBillPreferenceFilePath as string (),
	EBillReaderFalloutFileName as string (),
	EBillReaderFalloutPath as string (),
	FacetsDataSource as string (),
	FacetsPassword as string (),
	FacetsUserID as string (),
	TestVaraible as string (),
	varFilePath as string ()
}

source(output(
		GRGR_ID as string,
		SBSB_ID as string,
		EFF_DT as string,
		TERM_DT as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> FlatFileSource
FlatFileSource derive(EFF_DT = trim(EFF_DT),
		TERM_DT = left(trim(TERM_DT), 10),
		GRGR_ID = trim(GRGR_ID),
		SBSB_ID = trim(SBSB_ID)) ~> DerivedColumn
DerivedColumn sink(input(
		EBILL_EFF_DT as string,
		GRGR_ID as string,
		EBILL_TERM_DT as string,
		SBSB_ID as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	stagingSchemaName: 'dbo',
	saveOrder: 10000,
	insertable:true,
	deletable:false,
	upsertable:false,
	updateable:false,
	keys:[],
	mapColumn(
		EBILL_EFF_DT = EFF_DT,
		GRGR_ID,
		EBILL_TERM_DT = TERM_DT,
		SBSB_ID)) ~> OLEDBDestination
